_comment: Methodology thresholds from Facebook-Testing-Scaling-Research.md. Multipliers marked '_mult_of_be_cpa' are relative to THIS product's break-even CPA; '_mult_of_be_roas' relative to break-even ROAS. Benchmark numbers (hook/CTR/CPC/CPM) are US-ecom 2025-26 consensus — recalibrate to your own account after a few weeks.

early_kill._comment: Fast pre-CPA kill of clearly-dead creatives (methodology Part 2). Fires only on the full combination: enough impressions AND bad hook AND bad link-CTR AND zero ATC. CPM/CPC are NOT standalone triggers.

efficiency_kill._comment: Cost-efficiency kill grounded in the identity CPA = CPC / CVR. Kills when LINK-CPC (spend / link clicks) is so high that break-even is impossible EVEN AT an exceptional conversion rate. absolute_max_cpc = break_even_cpa * best_case_cvr * safety_multiple; kill when link-CPC exceeds it. Guards against false-kills: (a) spend gate so it can't fire on day-1 CPM noise, (b) min_link_clicks so CPC is real not a 1-click fluke, (c) best_case_cvr is deliberately GENEROUS (5% = 'exceptional' per Triple Whale FY2025 median 1.6%) so it only fires when NO realistic CVR could recover the ad. This is NOT a CPM kill — CPM alone stays a label.
